name: Rotary potentiometer (10 kOhm linear, breadboard)
description: Knob that gives a variable voltage on the wiper: outer legs to 3.3 V/5 V and GND, wiper to an analog input.
notes: Outer legs to the supply and GND of the microcontroller (3.3 V for ESP32/Pico, never 5 V on a 3.3 V ADC), wiper to the ADC pin.
About 0.05-0.1 W rating: never put it in a power path.
Leg spacing is about 5 mm (2 holes). Set params.ohms.
